paper_title: $M^3EL$ A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking
caption: : Entity topic distribution.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of entity topics within a dataset. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories “Moive,” “Common,” “Person,” “Book,” and “Sport.” The “Moive” category is represented by a light blue slice and accounts for approximately 41.2% of the total. “Common” is represented by a pink slice occupying roughly 30.5% of the chart, while “Person” is shown as a light red slice at approximately 9.1%. “Book” is represented by a pale yellow slice at 4.3% and “Sport” by a light green slice at 14.9%. A legend is present, labeling each category with a corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and the slices appear to be ordered descendingly by proportion, starting with “Moive” and progressing clockwise.
